ambiguities.text: Invalid inputs trigger 'OutOfGasError exceptions rather than returning error codes' - the exact error semantics are unclear
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume OutOfGasError consumes all remaining gas and causes the call to revert with no return data, consistent with EVM error handling patterns.

ambiguities.text: The handling of the identity point (0,0) with 'z-coordinate set to 0' is mentioned but not fully specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume identity point is handled as a special case in projective coordinates where (0,0,0) represents the point at infinity.

ambiguities.text: Input handling when provided data is shorter than expected (e.g., less than 128 bytes for add) is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume inputs are right-padded with zeros to reach expected length, consistent with other EVM precompile behavior.

implicit_assumptions.description: The cryptographic implementation correctly implements the BN128 curve operations without introducing vulnerabilities
